study: Expanded subject-separated offline MIT-BIH N/V beat classification
candidate_warning: Candidate records are provisional and require MLII, N/V support, subject identity and annotation audit before freezing. No scores have been computed for this expanded design.
features: Reuse src/week2_protocol.json exactly: 27 features, 216-sample annotation-centered MLII window at 360 Hz
models: Reuse majority, GaussianNB and RandomForest settings from src/week2_protocol.json without tuning on held-out records
uncertainty: Report across-record variation; any bootstrap must resample subjects rather than individual beats and state its small-sample limitations
preprocessing: Unchanged baseline first; any candidate modification is developed on training/development records only
holdout_policy: Original evaluation records are development data because their predictions have been inspected; holdout candidates must not influence feature or parameter choices
scope: Offline oracle-annotation-centered classification only; no automatic beat detection or clinical validation
